name: Mighty full visual and gameplay acceptance
scope: Current web client; approved original Mighty design; blocked capability is not silently excluded. No native mobile/Electron app claimed.

visual_states.expected: Room controls, vacant seats, self identity and join actions preserve original composition.
Five identities and ready/start state are aligned and readable.
Hand, own identity, suit/count choices, Pass/Bid and minimum/current contract are usable together.
Acting peer and pass/bid feedback readable; no stale own submission authority.
Kitty transfer, discard selection/count, contract/trump and confirmation remain understandable.
Public exchange status visible without exposing private kitty/hand information.
Friend and Joker-call choices, trump and declarer status visible and usable.
Legal hand interaction, turn, contract/trump/declarer/friend, round and score progress are usable.
Current trick ownership, acting peer, feedback and public facts remain clear.

Original compact current-hand summary, complete cumulative scoreboard and continuation are readable; current-hand review is secondary via 더보기, with no default 50-card matrix or live captured/stock fans.

Exactly the current completed hand opens directly; frozen identities, round/detail navigation, exit and next-hand retention match the original replay, with no archive browser or live-action authority.
Identity/name/score remain continuous through ready/shuffle and next hand.
All menu items reachable, correct grouping, dismiss and focus return.
Preferences scroll correctly, controls readable, keyboard/focus and dismiss work.
Players/observers/requests distinguished, identity and seat actions clear.
Rule navigation, examples and long Korean text readable without clipping.
Contract/trump/friend/progress and five-player scoreboard readable and grouped.

Room menu has no prior-session/archive browser or duplicate device-record browser; current-hand replay remains the only room record entry and original Home/StatsSheet device statistics remain separate and usable.
Reaction picker and peer/observer bubbles anchored without blocking gameplay.
Advice/inspection does not hide controls or imply an already-submitted action.
Korean/Latin long names, validation, text selection and focus survive resize.
Connection/loading/rejected-action states explain recovery without stale controls.
Complete friend card catalogue, held-card consequence, focus, cancellation and native confirmation remain readable and usable.
Ambiguous selected-card action picker shows complete native options, clear pending/selected state and unobstructed cancel/confirmation.
